title: Pause and resume tasks
request: Pause and resume a task: the person should be able to pause a running task and resume it later, from the UI. bh task status already knows active|paused; make it real in the Tasks page and the chat's tasks widget, and define what pausing does to work in flight.

steps.title: Define pause/resume semantics for in-flight work and update task status behavior in engine
steps.note: Defined pause as status=paused with in-progress steps stopped (timers recorded, moved to todo) via existing bh task status; UI can pause/resume without losing resume-from-next-unfinished behavior.

steps.title: Add pause/resume controls to Tasks page and chat tasks widget UI
steps.note: Added Pause/Resume controls on Tasks page detail and chat tasks widget; widget shows paused tasks and can toggle status; fixed agentHue to return hex for gpui-kit.

steps.title: Verify changes, run bh check, commit and push, rebuild and reinstall plugin
